speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are not dressed for a play. It is past the hour you usually complain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house plays Titus. I am not in it. I go at five, and not before.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I set dinner as if you were staying?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Set it. I am in the garret until five. The pot can be the ordinary one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it will be ordinary, and it will not wait while you make a virtue of staying home. Five is your affair. Noon is mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Noon I will keep. I have pages to read, and they are not the ones the house is playing.
